custody_note: New forecast made after the November 8 board announcement and November 9 lawsuit/market reaction. First GitHub commit introducing this file is the timestamp. This is not a backdated prediction, a previously locked November 8 forecast or evidence of an established accuracy score.
subject: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang status at February 10, 2027 deadline
author: KAHRELUM | analyst working estimate, AI-assisted; human editorial sign-off not independently established
probability_type: subjective scenario probabilities, not measured frequencies or bookmaker odds

outcomes.label: Remains Nvidia CEO
outcomes.criterion: Official Nvidia disclosures identify Jensen Huang as chief executive at 23:59 ET on February 10, 2027.

outcomes.label: No longer CEO via voluntary resignation or agreed succession
outcomes.criterion: He is no longer CEO at deadline and Nvidia's official stated primary departure mechanism is voluntary resignation, retirement or mutually agreed succession.

outcomes.label: No longer CEO through involuntary board removal
outcomes.criterion: He is no longer CEO at deadline and Nvidia explicitly attributes departure to involuntary termination or board removal.

rules: Resolve the company's officially identified CEO at 23:59 US Eastern on February 10, 2027.
Classify a non-CEO outcome by the best-supported disclosed reason; require written Nvidia board or SEC evidence for involuntary board removal.
February 10, 2027 is the settlement date. Acting or interim leadership alone does not establish permanent replacement when official filings continue to designate Huang CEO.
If a departure occurs for death, incapacity, hostile takeover or an otherwise uncategorizable mechanism, mark EXCEPTION/UNSCORED, not a retrospective reinterpretation of the three bins.
Any future revisions require a new dated file; never edit the original probability vector to fit evidence.
resolution.fallback_source: Nvidia SEC Form 8-K/10-Q and contemporaneous board press statements, checked against leadership page; preserve conflicts.

falsifiers: Official Nvidia announcement of successor appointment and Huang leaving CEO role before the deadline.
Independent board review announces material compromised information or governance noncompliance.
Official resolution finds no compromise and confirms continued leadership.
Verified subpoena, testimony, or law-enforcement announcement changes the oversight/operational trajectory.
